scope: Read-only input-provenance audit; no outcomes, model fit, selection, calibration, market score, or May data were read.

training_builder.behavior: Uses schedule probablePitcher when present, otherwise falls back to the boxscore actual starter.

runtime_feature_contract.behavior: Quarantines opposing-pitcher fields until a complete point-in-time pitcher source and live-equivalent fallback contract pass coverage audit.

decision.reason: The historical training row records source labels but no raw schedule payload hash, schedule receipt timestamp, or T-minus-4 observation timestamp. A probable pitcher retained in a completed-game schedule response is not proof that the same identity and statistics were available at the decision horizon.
decision.actual_starter_fallback: The 72 actual_starter rows are explicitly postgame and cannot be used as pregame feature evidence.
required_before_reconsideration: Raw payload and hash for each observation.
A live-equivalent as-of pitcher-statistics transformer with a defined fallback contract.
A new chronology, coverage, identity, fallback, and leakage mutation suite before fitting any challenger.
